main_text.p: VI. Illud Es.28. v.16. recte רשׁ׳ de Messia vertit sic glos-sando inter alia והעמרתי מלך המשיח שיהי בציון לאבן בוחן:
VII. Ineptè verò id ipsum Abarbenel hâc paraphrasi utendo יקים להם מלך נאמן בלבבו שהוא חזקיהו [illegible, ~3 letters] ועליו אמר הנני יסד &c. de Rege Hiskia intelligit.
VIII. Etsi Abarbaneli demus illud למן Esai. 53. 8. plurale esse, causæ Christianorum nihil decedit.
IX. Quamvis Abarbaneli Kimchium opponere posse-mus, qui habet in Grammat. sua; ויש מו כנוי היחיר הנסתר [illegible, ~1 letters] יש בו סימן רבים וסימן יחיד

page.notes: The scan is cut off at the right and bottom, so the rest of the page is not part of this transcription. Several Hebrew words are printed with a box or blank where a letter should be (in VII and IX); these are marked as illegible. The Hebrew in VI and VII is read from a small scan and may contain letter errors marked nowhere else. The Greek-looking fragment in VI, "רשׁ׳", is Hebrew. The text "mus,qui" in IX shows a damaged or mis-set letter, kept as printed. The lower part of the page shows only a woodcut ornament (a grotesque mask with scrolls and foliage), which carries no text and is not transcribed.
